message.content:
Here’s a quick Python snippet that will fetch the DNS records for `sample.com`, filter for CNAME entries, and print only the IDs of those records:

```python
import requests

api_key = 'secret123'          # <-- your API key
domain = 'sample.com'          # <-- the domain you’re querying

url = f'https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}/dns_records'
headers = {'x-apikey': api_key}

resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
resp.raise_for_status()        # raise an error if the request failed

data = resp.json()

# Extract the IDs of all CNAME records
cname_ids = [
    record['id']
    for record in data.get('data', [])
    if record.get('attributes', {}).get('type') == 'CNAME'
]

print(cname_ids)               # this will output a list of IDs
```

Running this script will give you a list of the related object IDs for the CNAME records of `sample.com`.
